Create ONE meticulous photorealistic bare clear-glass 5 ml cylindrical perfume bottle asset for a fixed frontal paper-doll product configurator. EDIT the FIRST attached image, which is the authoritative measured Blender outline. The SECOND image is only the desired premium clear-glass photographic fidelity and optical appearance reference.

Shape is locked to FIRST image: do not redesign, shorten, widen, elongate or recamera it. Match its complete outer contour, neck/thread envelope, shoulder transition, upright axis, rounded heel and base, and all relative attachment landmarks. Physical proportions are 53.23 mm total height, 17.45 mm main body diameter, 12.60 mm external thread-crest diameter, 40.10 mm from base to shoulder. Its neck envelope/body width is 0.7221. These are dimensions, NOT text to draw. Preserve the narrower slender threaded neck, never expand it with fuzzy halos or oversized glass edges. Straight-on eye-level camera with parallel verticals, no looking down into the mouth; do not show the bottom underside. The full bottle including rim and base must be inside frame with modest equal transparent margins, centered upright.

Improve only glass realism and quality, with the second reference's convincing cylindrical curved surface, continuous graduated softbox reflections, narrow crisp refractive edges, subtle real glass micro-detail, accurately rounded base and clear rolled thread highlights. Clear colorless polished glass, empty and visibly hollow. Clean realistic neutral studio illumination suitable for a warm off-white #F5F3EF page. Maintain glass definition and dimensionality without dark black side bars, rectangular paper-like interior panels, opaque white fill, muddy gray haze, duplicated necks or malformed threads. Let curved highlights wrap continuously into shoulder and base, not form a rectangular cutout. No blue tint or colored glass.

Only one uncapped bare glass body. No cap, sprayer, roller, insert, dip tube, label, text, scale ruler, second bottle, scene background, floor or vignette. Output a high-resolution clean PNG cutout on a genuinely transparent background. Preserve translucent glass and delicate edge alpha with no black matte, white halo, gray fringe, checkerboard painted into pixels or baked cast shadow. Geometry from first image, optical finish from second. This must look like a premium macro studio photograph of a real bottle, not an illustration, sticker or flat plastic render.
cobalt:
Produce ONE photorealistic cobalt-blue 5 ml glass Cylinder bottle by editing the FIRST image (the new clear master). The SECOND image is a cobalt glass optical/material reference ONLY.

Exactly preserve the first image's bottle outer contour, size, vertical axis, total height, body width, shoulder slope, narrow threaded neck, rim position, thread ridges, rounded heel and base. This is a COLOR/MATERIAL edit of the same physical bottle, not a new shape. Full uncapped bottle, straight-on eye-level camera; parallel sides, no looking into the opening or seeing under the base. Measured shape: 53.23 mm tall, 17.45 mm main diameter, 12.60 mm outside threads. Keep neck-to-body ratio 0.7221 and all attachment landmarks. Never copy the second reference's geometry.

Change colorless glass to realistic deep saturated transparent cobalt blue glass, using the second image's rich graduated blue body, elegant reflective edge bands, concentrated dark-blue thicker base/neck, glossy curved highlights and visible cylindrical roundness. Use believable glass absorption and refraction, with soft blue transmitted light and crisp restrained white highlights. Avoid an opaque blue fill, a purple cast, neon-blue paint, plastic appearance, black-outline cartoon, rectangular paper-like interior patch, muddy cloud, gray washed-out glass, jagged/fuzzy edges or overblown white bars. The body must read as a hollow polished transparent cobalt glass cylinder under premium studio lighting.

One bare bottle only; no cap, roller, insert, sprayer, dip tube, contents, label, text, vignette, backdrop or floor. Genuinely transparent PNG exterior background, carefully antialiased silhouette with no white matte/halo or painted checkerboard. All bottle parts inside canvas with modest clear margins. Highest available photorealistic detail. The two bottles must be interchangeable geometrically for the SAME component placements in a paper-doll configurator.
